newsitem.title: USA: Mobilemedia sees Q3 EBITDA about $35 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mobilemedia sees Q3 EBITDA about $35 mln.

text.p: MobileMedia Corp said Friday earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) for the third quarter ending September 30 are expected to be about $35 million.
The company cited continuing costs and increased subscriber churn associated with the integration of the operations of MobileComm.
The company's EBITDA for the third quarter 1995 was $16.3 million.

The company said third quarter results would, absent waivers or certain other events, place the company in violation of certain covenants in its bank credit agreement. The company said it is working with its banks as well as its financial advisors on measures to address these issues.
